name: @wealthai/astral-native
description: The React Native BINDING for @wealthai/astral (docs/49 ASTRAL-99). `packages/astral` is platform-neutral source; this is its RN host binding — the primitives adapter and the block dispatcher — living in a package rather than inside one app, so apps/mobile and apps/astro render ONE wheel, ONE scorecard and ONE input widget. The three app-local capabilities it needs (an auth token, a native multipart upload, a way to send a message) are INJECTED through `installAstralHost`, never imported from `@/lib/*` (F22).
